summary: Gravity Cannons are Nomai structures that launch shuttles with gravitational force and recall them using paired white hole warp cores. Two exist in the solar system: one on Brittle Hollow's equator (linked to Solanum's shuttle on the Quantum Moon) and one on Ember Twin's equator (linked to the shuttle on the Interloper).

behavior: Gravity Cannons can also launch other objects, including the player's spaceship, when activated.
Recalled Nomai shuttles can only receive thrust once from the Gravity Cannon and are very hard to aim.
location: Gravity Cannons exist on planets where the Nomai initially crash-landed: Brittle Hollow and Ember Twin.
Each Gravity Cannon has only two controls, located on a platform outside and under the firing platform.
The Brittle Hollow Gravity Cannon is at the planet's equator and aims directly upward.
The Brittle Hollow Gravity Cannon can be accessed from the planet's surface or from the Crossroads.
The Brittle Hollow Gravity Cannon usually falls into the planet's black hole near the end of the loop.
The Ember Twin Gravity Cannon is at the planet's equator and fires at an angle.
The Ember Twin Gravity Cannon can be accessed from the surface or from the Sunless City's Eye Shrine District.
The Brittle Hollow Gravity Cannon is linked to Solanum's Shuttle, currently resting on the Quantum Moon.
The Ember Twin Gravity Cannon is linked to a shuttle currently resting on the Interloper.
The shuttle on the Interloper contains Clary's corpse and a recording from her.
lore: Gravity Cannons may have been built by the early Nomai settlers as an early form of interplanetary travel before warp technology was reinvented.
The structural design and launch method of the Orbital Probe Cannon appears similar to the Gravity Cannons, suggesting they were an early precursor.
Solanum used the Brittle Hollow Gravity Cannon to launch toward the Quantum Moon for her pilgrimage.
Clary, Poke, and Pye landed on the Interloper using the Ember Twin Gravity Cannon's paired shuttle.
Clary's shuttle recording reports that Pye and Poke descended into a fissure on the Interloper's sunward side after detecting strange energy readings.
Clary lost contact with Pye and Poke after they descended into the Interloper and recorded her dilemma about whether to follow them.
Solanum's shuttle recording on the Quantum Moon describes her landing at the moon's south pole and her sense of readiness.
mechanics: Triggering the right control on a Gravity Cannon sends a signal to the paired shuttle's warp core to recall the shuttle.
Triggering the left control on a Gravity Cannon activates it, firing the shuttle out if it is currently in the cannon.
Both Gravity Cannon shuttles lack propulsion of their own and require the cannon to launch.
Once a shuttle has been recalled, the player can enter it, fire it from inside, recall it again, or stop it via the inside panel.
Recalling Solanum's shuttle from the Quantum Moon reveals her pilgrimage recording.
Recalling the Interloper shuttle reveals Clary's corpse and recording.
The Ember Twin shuttle returns to Ember Twin's Gravity Cannon when recalled.
The Brittle Hollow shuttle returns to Brittle Hollow's Gravity Cannon when recalled.
